description: Stop a Mailchimp campaign: action 'unschedule' puts a scheduled one back to a draft; 'cancel' stops one that is sending (emails already delivered stay delivered). Without confirm:true nothing changes and you get what would happen. Free. Needs Mailchimp connected (Connectors > Mailchimp, or connect_connector with an API key).
name: cancel_mailchimp_campaign
title: Stop a Mailchimp campaign
